title: Enforce 2 km radius cap for docs-pending pros on /api/pros

requirements.expectation: Pros with docs_status 'under_review' or 'rejected' are only shown to customers within DOCS_PENDING_MAX_RADIUS_KM (2 km), not the full marketplace radius.
requirements.verification: Unit test asserting /api/pros excludes a docs-pending pro beyond 2 km but within the normal 5 km radius.
evidence: code: src/app/api/pros/__tests__/route.test.ts asserts pro at 1.3 km (under_review) is included, while pros at 2.8 km with under_review or rejected are excluded.

requirements.expectation: Approved pros (and pros without review restrictions) remain discoverable up to MAX_RADIUS_KM + 0.75 (5.75 km).
requirements.verification: Unit test asserting /api/pros includes an approved pro at 3.5 km.
evidence: code: src/app/api/pros/__tests__/route.test.ts asserts approved pro at 2.8 km is included up to standard marketplace radius.

requirements.expectation: Response meta accurately reflects maxRadiusKm and docsPendingRadiusKm.
requirements.verification: Route test asserting meta structure and values.
evidence: code: src/app/api/pros/__tests__/route.test.ts asserts meta.maxRadiusKm is 5 and meta.docsPendingRadiusKm is 2.

requirements.expectation: Full test suite, typecheck and lint pass with no regressions.
evidence: code: 200 vitest test files (1,827 tests) pass; tsc --noEmit exit 0; eslint exit 0 with no new errors.

external: Live verification on deployed environment with docs-pending and approved test accounts.
